summary: Backend-only testing for Webfoot API. Validated root, leads CRUD (create/list/validation/limit-clamping), _id exclusion and status regression endpoints via the external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. 14/14 pytest tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is defined (line ~130) AFTER it is referenced in create_lead's except block (line ~98). At runtime the module fully loads before any request handling, so this works, but stylistically logger should be configured before routes that use it.
server.py uses `@app.on_event('shutdown')` which is deprecated in recent FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan handlers.

GET /api/leads silently clamps the limit parameter instead of validating via Pydantic Query (e.g., Query(100, ge=1, le=500)). Behaviour works but returning 422 for clearly invalid input would be more explicit.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded in all endpoints via projection {"_id": 0} — good.
created_at/timestamp are stored as ISO strings and converted back on read — consistent and avoids bson serialization issues.
seed_data_creation: Test suite created TEST_-prefixed leads and a TEST_client status entry during execution; cleaned up post-run via mongosh deleteMany on email/client_name matching /TEST_/.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend-only validated. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_webfoot_api.py is reusable as regression. External URL used: https://webfoot-dev.preview.emergentagent.com. All TEST_ prefixed seed data was cleaned; tests are idempotent and can be re-run safely.
